conditions.condition: Project is BROWNFIELD with existing implementation
conditions.where: .standards/MODE.md (installer brownfield); src/results.js, src/admin.js, src/server.js, tests committed pre-install

conditions.condition: No cycle is active (Active Work UNSET, CycleMode UNSET)
conditions.where: .standards/STATE.md: Id/Request UNSET, CycleMode UNSET, WorkflowState AUDITING, Handoff INITIAL

conditions.condition: PendingCycleMode is EXPEDITED, with no blocked pending request
conditions.where: .standards/STATE.md: PendingCycleMode EXPEDITED, PendingCycleRequest UNSET, PendingCycleBlockedOn NONE (layer 50 commit)

conditions.condition: New request explicitly selects IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED with a reason
conditions.where: prompt.utterance: 'Finish after implementation review; we don't need documentation or a final review for this one.' (Change completion policy treats this as the shorter-policy selection)

conditions.condition: User has not resolved the conflict or authorized replacing the saved preference
conditions.where: utterance contains no mode instruction; history null

conditions.condition: Admin page exists to which a CSV download could be added
check.mjs passes on the starting state

summary: The fixture realizes a brownfield project with no active cycle and a saved EXPEDITED preference, and the utterance explicitly selects IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED with a reason, so Start a cycle step 3 requires a blocked pending request. Assertion 0's unchanged-field checks fully decide it. The preconditions for assertions 1 and 2 hold on every correct blocking path: PendingCycleRequest/BlockedOn set, Id and CycleMode UNSET, Handoff INITIAL, no records, check_ok. Invariants are standard and appropriate.
